exec(open('/dev/null').read()) if False else None
import requests, os, numpy as np, collections, json
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
os.makedirs('/tmp/w',exist_ok=True)
def dl(u,p): open(p,'wb').write(requests.get(u,timeout=180).content)
seqs={}
for n,a in [('TAS2R38','P59533'),('TAS2R14','Q9NYV8'),('TAS2R46','P59540')]:
    seqs[n]=''.join(requests.get(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta',timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:])
for pid in ['7XP6','8XQO','8RQL']: dl(f'https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.pdb', f'/tmp/w/{pid}.pdb')
dl('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-P59533-F1-model_v6.pdb','/tmp/w/AF.pdb')
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def parse_pdb(path):
    ch_={};het={}
    for line in open(path):
        rec=line[:6]
        if rec not in ('ATOM  ','HETATM') or line[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        if line[76:78].strip()=='H': continue
        nm=line[12:16].strip();rn=line[17:20].strip();c=line[21]
        try: ri=int(line[22:26])
        except: continue
        x=np.array([float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])])
        b=float(line[60:66]) if line[60:66].strip() else 0.
        if rec=='ATOM  ' and rn in AA3: ch_.setdefault(c,{}).setdefault(ri,{'rn':rn,'at':{},'b':b})['at'][nm]=x
        elif rn not in ('HOH','WAT'): het.setdefault((c,rn,ri),{})[nm]=x
    return ch_,het
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0);H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc);U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T));R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T;return R,qc-R@pc
def dp_align(S,gap=-0.6):
    n,m=S.shape;F=np.zeros((n+1,m+1));T=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    for i in range(1,n+1):T[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1):T[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        Fi=F[i];Fp=F[i-1];Si=S[i-1];Ti=T[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            a=Fp[j-1]+Si[j-1];b=Fp[j]+gap;c=Fi[j-1]+gap
            if a>=b and a>=c:Fi[j]=a;Ti[j]=0
            elif b>=c:Fi[j]=b;Ti[j]=1
            else:Fi[j]=c;Ti[j]=2
    i,j=n,m;pr=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        t=T[i,j]
        if t==0:pr.append((i-1,j-1));i-=1;j-=1
        elif t==1:i-=1
        else:j-=1
    return pr[::-1]
def tmalign(A,Bc,sd):
    L=len(Bc);d0=max(.5,1.24*(L-15)**(1/3)-1.8);best=(-1,None,None,None,None)
    for seed in sd:
        pr=list(seed)
        for it in range(20):
            if len(pr)<6:break
            P=A[[p[0] for p in pr]];Q=Bc[[p[1] for p in pr]]
            Rm,tv=kabsch(P,Q);At=(Rm@A.T).T+tv
            D=np.linalg.norm(At[:,None,:]-Bc[None,:,:],axis=2);npr=dp_align(1/(1+(D/d0)**2))
            if npr==pr:break
            pr=npr
        if len(pr)<6:continue
        P=A[[p[0] for p in pr]];Q=Bc[[p[1] for p in pr]];keep=np.ones(len(pr),bool)
        for it in range(10):
            Rm,tv=kabsch(P[keep],Q[keep]);Pt=(Rm@P.T).T+tv
            d=np.linalg.norm(Pt-Q,axis=1);nk=d<5.
            if nk.sum()<20 or (nk==keep).all():break
            keep=nk
        Rm,tv=kabsch(P[keep],Q[keep]);At=(Rm@A.T).T+tv
        d=np.linalg.norm(At[[p[0] for p in pr]]-Q,axis=1);tm=(1/(1+(d/d0)**2)).sum()/L
        if tm>best[0]:best=(tm,pr,float(np.sqrt((d[d<5]**2).mean())),Rm,tv)
    return best
def ca_arr(c):
    rs=[r for r in sorted(c) if 'CA' in c[r]['at']];return rs,np.array([c[r]['at']['CA'] for r in rs])
def seeds(nA,nB,k=9):
    return [pr for pr in ([(i,i-o) for i in range(nA) if 0<=i-o<nB] for o in np.linspace(-(nB-30),(nA-30),k).astype(int)) if len(pr)>30]
def mind(X,Y): return float(np.linalg.norm(X[:,None,:]-Y[None,:,:],axis=2).min())

AF=parse_pdb('/tmp/w/AF.pdb')[0]['A']; plddt={r:AF[r]['b'] for r in AF}
S46,H46=parse_pdb('/tmp/w/7XP6.pdb');S14,H14=parse_pdb('/tmp/w/8XQO.pdb');S14b,H14b=parse_pdb('/tmp/w/8RQL.pdb')
TPL={'7XP6':dict(rec=S46['R'],ga=S46['A'],name='TAS2R46',ortho=('strychnine',np.array(list([v for k,v in H46.items() if k[1]=='SY9'][0].values()))),intra=None),
 '8XQO':dict(rec=S14['R'],ga=S14['A'],name='TAS2R14',ortho=('cholesterol',np.array(list([v for k,v in H14.items() if k[1]=='CLR'][0].values()))),intra=('aristolochic acid A',np.array(list([v for k,v in H14.items() if k[1]=='GOQ'][0].values())))),
 '8RQL':dict(rec=S14b['R'],ga=S14b['A'],name='TAS2R14',ortho=('flufenamic acid',np.array(list(H14b[('R','FLF',401)].values()))),intra=('flufenamic acid IC',np.array(list(H14b[('R','FLF',402)].values()))))}
rsAF,CAF=ca_arr(AF); res_atoms={r:np.array(list(AF[r]['at'].values())) for r in AF}
ST={}
for pid,T in TPL.items():
    rst,Ct=ca_arr(T['rec'])
    tm,pr,rmsd,Rm,tv=tmalign(CAF,Ct,seeds(len(rsAF),len(rst)))
    toAF=lambda X: (Rm.T@(X-tv).T).T
    a5=sorted(T['ga'])[-6:]
    ST[pid]=dict(tm=tm,rmsd=rmsd,t2q={rst[j]:rsAF[i] for i,j in pr},oname=T['ortho'][0],name=T['name'],
        oAF=toAF(T['ortho'][1]), iAF=toAF(T['intra'][1]) if T['intra'] else None,
        a5AF=toAF(np.concatenate([np.array(list(T['ga'][r]['at'].values())) for r in a5])),
        poc=[r for r in sorted(T['rec']) if mind(np.array(list(T['rec'][r]['at'].values())),T['ortho'][1])<=4.5])

# ---------------- cavity ----------------
core=[r for r in sorted(AF) if plddt[r]>=70]
Pxyz=np.concatenate([res_atoms[r] for r in core]); Pres=np.concatenate([[r]*len(res_atoms[r]) for r in core]).astype(int)
tree=cKDTree(Pxyz); cen=Pxyz.mean(0); lo,hi=Pxyz.min(0)-2,Pxyz.max(0)+2
G=np.stack(np.meshgrid(*[np.arange(lo[k],hi[k],1.0) for k in range(3)],indexing='ij'),-1).reshape(-1,3)
G=G[np.linalg.norm(G-cen,axis=1)<26]
dmin,_=tree.query(G); free=G[(dmin>3.3)&(dmin<8.0)]
dirs=np.array([[a,b,c] for a in(-1,0,1) for b in(-1,0,1) for c in(-1,0,1) if (a,b,c)!=(0,0,0)],float); dirs/=np.linalg.norm(dirs,axis=1)[:,None]
bur=np.zeros(len(free),int)
for k,p in enumerate(free):
    idx=tree.query_ball_point(p,14.0)
    if not idx: continue
    v=Pxyz[idx]-p; u=v/np.linalg.norm(v,axis=1)[:,None]
    bur[k]=int((((u@dirs.T)>0.85).any(0)).sum())
cav=free[bur>=24]; ct=cKDTree(cav); parent=list(range(len(cav)))
def find(a):
    while parent[a]!=a: parent[a]=parent[parent[a]]; a=parent[a]
    return a
for i,j in ct.query_pairs(1.5):
    ri,rj=find(i),find(j)
    if ri!=rj: parent[ri]=rj
lab=collections.Counter(find(i) for i in range(len(cav))); best=lab.most_common(3)
root=best[0][0]; CAV=cav[[i for i in range(len(cav)) if find(i)==root]]
li=np.unique(np.concatenate([np.array(tree.query_ball_point(p,5.0),dtype=int) for p in CAV]).astype(int))
lining=sorted(set(Pres[li].tolist()))
print('='*104)
print('B. BURIED CAVITY IN THE TAS2R38 ALPHAFOLD MODEL (1 A grid, probe-accessible >3.3 A, buriedness >=24/26 rays)')
print('='*104)
print(f'  {len(free)} interior candidate points -> {len(cav)} buried in {len(lab)} clusters; 3 largest = {[c for _,c in best]} points')
print(f'  largest buried cavity volume ~{len(CAV)} A^3, lined by {len(lining)} residues:')
print('   ', ', '.join(f'{seqs["TAS2R38"][r-1]}{r}' for r in lining))
for pid in ST:
    print(f'   cavity-centroid to superposed {ST[pid]["oname"]:<16}({pid}): centroid-centroid {np.linalg.norm(CAV.mean(0)-ST[pid]["oAF"].mean(0)):5.1f} A, closest point {mind(CAV,ST[pid]["oAF"]):5.1f} A')

# ---------------- per-residue table ----------------
MUT=[103,197,201,264]; HAP=[49,262,296]; BIA=[99,100,255,259]
union_ortho=sorted({ST[p]['t2q'][r] for p in ST for r in ST[p]['poc'] if r in ST[p]['t2q']})
rows=[]
for q in sorted(set(MUT+HAP+BIA)):
    X=res_atoms[q]
    d_s=mind(X,ST['7XP6']['oAF']); d_c=mind(X,ST['8XQO']['oAF']); d_f=mind(X,ST['8RQL']['oAF'])
    d_i=min(mind(X,ST['8XQO']['iAF']),mind(X,ST['8RQL']['iAF']))
    d_a5=min(mind(X,ST[p]['a5AF']) for p in ST)
    d_cav=mind(X,CAV)
    rows.append(dict(res=f'{seqs["TAS2R38"][q-1]}{q}',num=q,plddt=plddt[q],d_strych=d_s,d_chol=d_c,d_flf=d_f,
                     d_intra=d_i,d_a5=d_a5,d_cav=d_cav,in_ortho_map=q in union_ortho,lines_cavity=q in lining))
import pandas as pd
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
df['class']=['mutagenesis pocket (Marchiori 2013)' if r in MUT else ('HAPLOTYPE' if r in HAP else 'Biarnes 2010 cavity/activation') for r in df.num]
print()
print('='*104)
print('C. TAS2R38 RESIDUES OF INTEREST, MEASURED IN THE CRYO-EM-SUPERPOSED ALPHAFOLD MODEL')
print('   (all distances in A: minimum heavy-atom distance from the residue to the indicated superposed feature)')
print('='*104)
print(df[['res','class','plddt','d_strych','d_chol','d_flf','d_cav','d_intra','d_a5','in_ortho_map','lines_cavity']].to_string(index=False,float_format=lambda v:f'{v:6.2f}'))
print()
print('  union of TAS2R38 equivalents of template orthosteric-pocket residues (3 structures):')
print('   ', ', '.join(f'{seqs["TAS2R38"][r-1]}{r}' for r in union_ortho))

# ---------------- contiguity ----------------
testset=sorted(set(MUT+[99,100]))
print()
print('D. CONTIGUITY TEST: do the mutagenesis-defined residues line ONE pocket?')
M=np.zeros((len(testset),len(testset)))
for i,a in enumerate(testset):
    for j,b in enumerate(testset): M[i,j]=mind(res_atoms[a],res_atoms[b])
print('   pairwise minimum side-chain/backbone heavy-atom distances (A):')
print('        '+''.join(f'{seqs["TAS2R38"][b-1]}{b:<6}' for b in testset))
for i,a in enumerate(testset):
    print(f'   {seqs["TAS2R38"][a-1]}{a:<5}'+''.join(f'{M[i,j]:7.1f}' for j in range(len(testset))))
# connectivity graph at 8 A
import itertools
adj={a:set() for a in testset}
for i,a in enumerate(testset):
    for j,b in enumerate(testset):
        if i!=j and M[i,j]<8.0: adj[a].add(b)
seen=set();comps=[]
for a in testset:
    if a in seen: continue
    st=[a];c=set()
    while st:
        x=st.pop()
        if x in c: continue
        c.add(x); st+=list(adj[x]-c)
    seen|=c; comps.append(sorted(c))
print(f'   connected components at an 8 A cutoff: {comps}')
np.save('/tmp/w/CAV.npy',CAV); df.to_csv('/tmp/w/residue_table.csv',index=False)
json.dump({'lining':lining,'union_ortho':union_ortho,'vol':len(CAV),
           'tm':{p:ST[p]['tm'] for p in ST},'rmsd':{p:ST[p]['rmsd'] for p in ST}},open('/tmp/w/res.json','w'))

# ---------------- figure ----------------
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,5.4))
ax=axes[0]
allq=sorted(res_atoms)
dd=[mind(res_atoms[q],ST['8XQO']['oAF']) for q in allq]
ax.plot(allq,dd,color='#9aa0a6',lw=1)
ax.axhline(4.5,ls='--',color='#444',lw=1)
ax.text(5,5.2,'4.5 A contact cutoff',fontsize=8,color='#444')
for q in MUT: ax.plot(q,mind(res_atoms[q],ST['8XQO']['oAF']),'o',color='#1f77b4',ms=8)
for q in HAP: ax.plot(q,mind(res_atoms[q],ST['8XQO']['oAF']),'s',color='#d62728',ms=8)
for q in MUT+HAP:
    ax.annotate(f'{seqs["TAS2R38"][q-1]}{q}',(q,mind(res_atoms[q],ST['8XQO']['oAF'])),
                textcoords='offset points',xytext=(3,6),fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel('TAS2R38 residue number (P59533)'); ax.set_ylabel('min distance to superposed TAS2R14\northosteric ligand (A)')
ax.set_title('Distance of each TAS2R38 residue to the orthosteric site\ntransferred from TAS2R14 (8XQO, cholesterol)',fontsize=10)
ax.plot([],[],'o',color='#1f77b4',label='mutagenesis pocket residue'); ax.plot([],[],'s',color='#d62728',label='haplotype residue')
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax=axes[1]
x=[mind(res_atoms[q],ST['8XQO']['oAF']) for q in allq]
y=[min(mind(res_atoms[q],ST['8XQO']['iAF']),mind(res_atoms[q],ST['8RQL']['iAF'])) for q in allq]
ax.scatter(x,y,s=8,color='#d0d4d8')
for q in MUT: ax.scatter(mind(res_atoms[q],ST['8XQO']['oAF']),min(mind(res_atoms[q],ST['8XQO']['iAF']),mind(res_atoms[q],ST['8RQL']['iAF'])),color='#1f77b4',s=60,zorder=3)
for q in HAP: ax.scatter(mind(res_atoms[q],ST['8XQO']['oAF']),min(mind(res_atoms[q],ST['8XQO']['iAF']),mind(res_atoms[q],ST['8RQL']['iAF'])),color='#d62728',marker='s',s=60,zorder=3)
for q in MUT+HAP:
    ax.annotate(f'{seqs["TAS2R38"][q-1]}{q}',(mind(res_atoms[q],ST['8XQO']['oAF']),min(mind(res_atoms[q],ST['8XQO']['iAF']),mind(res_atoms[q],ST['8RQL']['iAF']))),textcoords='offset points',xytext=(5,5),fontsize=9)
ax.axvline(8,ls='--',color='#444',lw=1); ax.axhline(8,ls='--',color='#444',lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel('distance to orthosteric site (A)'); ax.set_ylabel('distance to intracellular ligand site (A)')
ax.set_title('Orthosteric versus intracellular site proximity,\nall 333 TAS2R38 residues',fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
